_about: Postgame. The first three chapters were played in the natural run (natural-run-v102 rows 207–211). The rest are written from game data and the project’s own audits and are flagged `source` so the page says so.

chapters.title: After the Credits
chapters.goal: Find your feet as Champion of three regions and learn how to travel between them.
quick: Continue from the title screen
You resume in Littleroot Town outside Professor Birch’s lab with your party healed.
Talk to Professor Birch
He is in his lab and points you to the truck.
Use the truck to reach Kanto
Rear door, east end, from below: ‘Call the truck to Pallet Town?’
Fly anywhere
In Kanto and Johto the Fly map is the combined Johto–Kanto map again.

p: The truck is the link between Hoenn and the older regions. In Littleroot, stand below the rear door at the truck’s east end and press A: it offers to take you to Pallet Town and reminds you that you can return any time. The same door in Pallet brings you back.
Fly uses the map of the region you are standing in. After the truck ride to Pallet, every Johto and Kanto town you have visited is available again.
The ferry S.S. Tidal sails inside Hoenn between Slateport and Lilycove; the S.S. Aqua sails between Olivine and Vermilion. They are separate ships with separate tickets.

stuck: How do I return to Pallet Town from Hoenn?
Fly to Littleroot Town. At the truck, stand below the rear door at its east end, face up and press A, then choose Yes.
Where am I after the Hoenn credits?
Choose Continue on the title screen. You are in Littleroot Town, outside Professor Birch’s lab.

chapters.title: Hoenn Gym Rematches
chapters.goal: Challenge each Hoenn Leader again with six Pokémon at Level 98–100.
quick: Visit a Hoenn Gym and talk to its Leader
They greet you, then ask: ‘Will you accept the rematch?’
Answer Yes or No
No closes the conversation with no battle and no cost.
Seven rematches are Single Battles; Tate & Liza remain a Double Battle.
Repeat as often as you like
The offer is available again immediately.

p: Each Leader has a second team of six. In the playthrough Roxanne was fought: a Single Battle led by Mega Aerodactyl at Level 98, paying ¥10,000, with the offer available again straight away.

The other seven rematch teams below come from the game’s trainer data. They were not fought in the playthrough, so the walk to each Leader and any puzzle state inside their Gym after the League is not confirmed here.
If you have not yet collected a Leader’s original Gym reward, they give it to you before offering the rematch.

stuck: How do I rematch Roxanne and the other Hoenn Leaders?
Become Hoenn Champion, then talk to the Leader in their Gym and answer Yes to ‘Will you accept the rematch?’
Can I decline a rematch?
Yes. Choose No and the conversation ends with no battle.

chapters.title: The S.S. Tidal
chapters.goal: Sail Hoenn’s ferry and learn how to finish the voyage.
need: Hoenn League Champion and the S.S. Ticket.
quick: Go to Slateport Harbor
Talk to the sailor and show your Ticket.
Choose Lilycove City
You board at once.
Rest in the bed in cabin No. 2
Walking the corridor does not end the voyage. The bed does.
Talk to the sailor at the exit
You have made land.

p: The Harbor sailor asks for your Ticket and offers a destination menu. On board, the corridor sailor tells you it will be some time before landfall and that your cabin is No. 2.

In the playthrough roughly 390 steps along the corridor did not finish the trip. Resting in the bed in cabin No. 2 ends it immediately: ‘We have made land in Lilycove City.’ Then talk to the sailor at the exit.
Trainers on board can be battled once each. Lilycove’s Harbor offers the return trip; its destination menu opens with the cursor on Exit.

stuck: The S.S. Tidal never arrives
Go to cabin No. 2 and rest in the bed. The ship then docks.
Where is the S.S. Tidal?
Slateport Harbor and Lilycove Harbor, after the Hoenn League. Talk to the sailor inside with the S.S. Ticket.

chapters.title: Steven & Wally
chapters.goal: Find Champion Steven and Wally for their final battles.
quick: Champion Steven
Six Pokémon at Level 99–100, with Mega Metagross.
Wally
Five Pokémon at Level 98–100.

p: Both battles exist in the shipped game with the teams shown below. They were not fought in the playthrough, so this guide does not yet describe the route to them or the exact conditions; the places listed are the maps whose scripts start each battle.
Steven fights as Champion Steven, with Champion music and a ¥20,000 prize.

bosses.title: Champion Steven
know: Mega Metagross is Steel / Psychic: Fire, Ground, Ghost and Dark moves.

stuck: Where is Wally after the League?
His final team is in the game, but the playthrough did not reach that battle. The Trainer page lists the map its script is on.

chapters.title: Johto Leader Rematches
chapters.goal: Face the Johto Gym Leaders’ second teams.
need: Not confirmed. The battles are in the game; what opens the Dojo’s VIP room was not traced.
quick: Go to Saffron City’s Fighting Dojo
The Leaders gather in its VIP room.
Talk to a Leader and accept
Each has six Pokémon around Level 65–68.

p: Eight Johto Leaders have rematch teams in the trainer table, shown below. The rematches were not played in the natural run. The guide lists the teams and where the scripts live, and leaves the unlock condition unstated rather than guess.

stuck: How do I rematch the Johto Gym Leaders?
Their second teams are fought in the Saffron City Fighting Dojo. The condition that opens it is not confirmed in this guide yet.

chapters.title: Legendary Pokémon
chapters.goal: Find and catch every Legendary and Mythical Pokémon the game offers.
need: Varies by Pokémon. Eighteen can be caught during the story, eleven after a milestone and three only after the Hoenn League.
quick: Open the field guide
Thirty-two entries, each with where to start, what you need, the steps, the encounter and what happens afterwards.
Save before each one
Fleeing is safe almost everywhere; Celebi’s shrine battle is the exception.
A knock-out is not final
Most return at your next League win as Kanto Champion. Kyogre, Groudon and Rayquaza follow Hoenn’s League instead.
Arceus is fought twice
Only the second battle can end in a capture.
stuck: Can I catch Groudon, Kyogre or Rayquaza during the story?

No. In the story they wake and leave. After the Hoenn League each waits at Level 85: Rayquaza on the Sky Pillar, Kyogre in the Marine Cave under Route 127 and Groudon in the Terra Cave on Route 114. One of each per save.
I knocked out a legendary Pokémon. Is it gone?
Not for good. Most return the next time you enter the Hall of Fame as Kanto Champion. Kyogre, Groudon and Rayquaza return after your next Hoenn League win instead.
I can’t throw a Poké Ball at Arceus
That is its first battle: Level 100, and it has to be knocked out. The second battle follows at once, at Level 80, and that one can be caught.
Where are Regirock, Regice and Registeel?
In the Sinjoh Ruins, not in Hoenn. Their chambers open as you collect plates in the Sinjoh story, which starts with the Azure Flute on Mt. Silver.

chapters.title: Far-off Places
chapters.sub: Alola’s isles, Sinjoh & the Safari Zones
chapters.goal: A map of the areas that sit outside the three regions’ main roads.
need: Not traced. None of these areas was visited in the natural playthrough except the Johto Safari Zone’s entrance.
quick: Alola isles
Melemele, Akala, Ula’ula and Poni, with Alolan forms in their encounter tables.
Sinjoh
New Sinjoh, Routes 49–50, Snowswept Cavern and the Sinjoh Ruins.
Safari Zones
Johto’s (via Cianwood; entrance played), Kanto’s in Fuchsia, Hoenn’s on Route 121.
Islands
Southern Island and Birth Island.

p: Project Blonde contains whole areas beyond the three regions. Their maps, wild Pokémon, items and Trainers are in the game data and each has a page in the World atlas, linked below.

How to reach them was not verified by play. Rather than guess at tickets and triggers, this chapter points to the data: open a place to see its area maps and encounter tables, including the Alolan forms found on the isles.

stuck: How do I get to the Alola isles or Sinjoh?
This guide has not verified the route. The places and their Pokémon are documented in the World atlas from game data.

chapters.title: Battle Facilities
chapters.goal: Know which battle facilities the game contains.
quick: Battle Tents
Verdanturf, Fallarbor and Slateport each have a tent lobby.
Trainer Hill
Its entrance has a shop.
Battle Frontier
Reached by the S.S. Aqua according to the project’s notes.

p: These facilities exist as maps in the shipped game. None was entered in the natural playthrough, and their rules, rewards and unlock conditions are not documented here yet. The World atlas shows their maps.
